sn47.7:1.1: Atthi bhikkhave Himavato pabbatarājassa duggā visamā desā || yattha neva makkaṭānaṃ cāri na manussānaṃ || || 4.
sn47.7:1.2: Atthi bhikkhave Himavato pabbatarājassa duggā visamā desā || yattha makkaṭānaṃ hi kho cāri na manussānaṃ || || 5.
sn47.7:1.3: Atthi Himavato pabbatarājassa samā bhūmibhāgā ramanīyā || yattha makkaṭānañceva cāri manussānañ ca || ||
sn47.7:1.4: Tatra bhikkhave luddā makkaṭavīthīsu lepam oḍḍenti makkaṭānam bādhanāya || ||
sn47.7:2.1: Tatra bhikkhave ye te makkaṭā abālajātikā alolajātikā te taṃ lepaṃ disvā ārakā parivajjanti || ||
sn47.7:2.2: Yo pana so hoti makkaṭo bālajātiko lolajātiko || so tam lepam upasaṅkamitvā hatthena gaṇhāti ||
sn47.7:2.8: Ubho hatthe mocessāmīti pādam cā ti dutiyena pādena gaṇhāti
sn47.7:2.10: Ubho hatthe mocessāmi pāde cā ti tuṇḍena gaṇhāti
sn47.7:2.12: Evaṃ hi so bhikkhave makkaṭo pañcoḍḍito thunam seti anayam āpanno byasanam āpanno yathākāmakaraṇīyo luddassa || ||
sn47.7:2.13: Tam enam bhikkhave luddo vijjhitvā tasmiṃ yeva kaṭṭhakataṅgāre avasajjetvā yena kāmam pakkamati || || 7.
sn47.7:2.14: Evaṃ hi tam bhikkhave hoti yo agocare carati paravisaye ||
sn47.7:3.1: tasmā ti ha bhikkhave mā agocare carittha paravisaye ||
sn47.7:3.2: agocare bhikkhave caratam paravisaye lacchati Māro otāraṃ lacchati Māro ārammanaṃ || || 8.
sn47.7:3.3: Ko ca bhikkhave bhikkhuno agocaro paravisayo || ||
sn47.7:3.7: Cakkhu viññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā ||
sn47.7:3.11: Kāyaviññeyyā poṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā || kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā || ||
sn47.7:4.1: Gocare bhikkhave caratha sake pettike visaye ||
sn47.7:4.2: Gocare bhikkhave carataṃ sake pettike visaye na lacchati Māro otāram na lacchati Māro ārammaṇaṃ || || 11.
sn47.7:4.3: Ko ca bhikkhave bhikkhuno gocaro sako pettiko visayo || ||
sn47.7:4.7: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ ||
sn47.7:4.10: Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || ||
sn47.7:4.11: Ayam bhikkhave bhikkhuno gocaro sako pettiko visayo ti || ||
